#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: W-What?! You beat me?! I can’t believe it! I emptied a whole mag into the sea!
Policeman: No! I don’t want to disappear! Fear me! I’m begging you!
You: G-Get lost, dude!
Policeman: Don’t give me that bullshit! I was fishing with a literal gun! Ain’t no one beating that!
Policeman: S-Second round? Yes! Best of two!
#Policeman.Face.normal
???: Ekhem!
Policeman: O-Oh, it’s you…
